long_description: Ensemble AI is building the operational intelligence layer for the world's industrial assets. Industrial companies run some of the world's most complex and valuable physical assets, but the engineering, maintenance and operational data behind them remains fragmented across systems, documents and teams. Ensemble has built Flux, an AI-native industrial software platform that connects this fragmented information and turns it into usable operational intelligence across the asset lifecycle - from capital projects and handover through operations, maintenance and asset integrity. Flux is designed for the reality of large industrial enterprises. Customers can start with a specific high-value application and expand across workflows, sites and asset portfolios, creating a shared intelligence layer that becomes increasingly valuable over time. Our Product Engineers work alongside customer teams to integrate Flux into complex operational environments, configure applications around real workflows and accelerate time to value - without turning the product into bespoke software. We believe the next generation of industrial software will do more than store records or digitise workflows. It will continuously understand industrial assets, their history, their condition and the operational context around them - and use that understanding to help people make better decisions and run them more effectively. That's what we're building with Flux.
